title: Unit reference instructions
responsibility: Build agent instructions for referencing a bounded list of unit IDs.

inputs.name: referencePrompt.ids
inputs.description: Candidate unit IDs to list in the instructions. Only IDs accepted by isUnitId are retained, duplicate IDs keep their first occurrence, and the list is capped at 120.

inputs.name: referencePrompt.discover
inputs.description: When true, the instructions require reading another unit’s canonical manifest at the selected revision and using only its verified ID. When false, the instructions say to name an unlisted unit in plain words; the default is false.

outputs.name: referencePrompt
outputs.description: A three-line instruction string that lists retained IDs as [[unit:<id>]] references or says none. Its second line gives unlisted-unit guidance based on discover.
examples:
Name a unit as [[unit:<id>]] with its registered id, never by a file name, a path or a
guessed id. Name a unit that is not listed here in plain words.
Units you may name: [[unit:desktop.function.reference-prompt]]

Name a unit as [[unit:<id>]] with its registered id, never by a file name, a path or a
guessed id. For another unit, first read its canonical manifest at the selected revision; use only its verified id.
Units you may name: none
